description: A NEAR standard (NEP) from github.com/near/NEPs: by number for the full text with status, category, what it requires, replaces or is superseded by; or by words to find one (e.g. "fungible token", "storage", "meta transactions"). Use when implementing FT, NFT, storage management, events, source metadata or wallet standards.
